title: utv-core (Java) component diagram
description: The Java library and its tests. The library depends only on Jackson and the JDK; the tests also use JUnit and read the shared conformance material in place. The library's code never reads schema/ (its kind table is a copy, see the source folder's backlog).

components.name: utv-core (Java)
components.responsibility: One Maven project: the library jar and its tests.

components.name: Library (net.icelander.utv)
components.responsibility: The typed layer, the 0.2 JSON layer, the text form, structural validation and java.time interop, in one package.

components.name: Tests (net.icelander.utv, test scope)
components.responsibility: The shared fixture runners, typed-layer and interop tests, and the UTV-first and native-first example suites.

components.name: Shared conformance material
components.responsibility: Everyday and text-form fixtures, the demo zone rules and the structural examples every library tests against.

components.name: Jackson databind 2.17.2
components.responsibility: JSON values (JsonNode, ObjectNode) and parsing with strict duplicate-key detection.

components.name: java.time (JDK)
components.responsibility: The language's own date and time API, and the JDK's bundled tz database.

components.name: JUnit Jupiter 5.10.3
components.responsibility: The test framework: @Test, @Nested, @ParameterizedTest and dynamic tests.

relationships.description: Run by mvn test (Surefire); not in the jar.
UTV JSON values are Jackson nodes; Utv.parse enables STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION.
JavaTime and the typed from/to methods convert to and from java.time; toZonedDateTime checks offsets against the JDK's tz database.
Exercise the JSON layer, the typed layer and interop.
Read everyday.json, text-form.json, demo-zones.json and the examples from ../../conformance, never a copy.
Each example compares UTV with java.time; native-first zone tests read the JDK's tz database.
